# Overview: Ireland Total Overhaul has fourteen nested decision categories, 144
# primary actions in this file, four additional Marine Service actions, and 54
# mapped mission families. The four Marine Service actions are kept in
# ireland_marine_service.txt so their category can be audited independently.
# Most route actions use custom-cost presentation with a named-ledger scarcity
# surcharge deducted in the completion effect; seven institutional actions use
# native cost fields and shared completion effects by design.
# Command-power charges use the same ledger-sensitive model. The maximum command-power charge
# is the fixed action base plus at most ten, staying below the sixty-point ceiling.
# Per-action ai_hint_pp_cost values give the AI a worst-case PP budget signal.
# Result recording uses the shared numeric mission-result interface: 1 full, 2 partial, 3 failure, 4 cancellation, 5 escalation.
# Physical inputs in this file use local macros because the stockpile and fuel
# fields below are documented vanilla macro consumers. These inputs are
# consumable project commitments. Mission cleanup never restores them in full;
# explicit cancellation paths may return the capped recoverable fraction documented below.
# Local staff and transport pools are explicit costs for named polling, cultural,
# tillage, border, and relief work; they are not passive political-power substitutes.
# ai_hint_pp_cost is a literal-only parser field. Keep its four file-local
# macros synchronized with the matching ireland.parliament_*_pp_cost script
# constants used by the shared executors and visible GUI labels.

			ireland_execute_parliament_dail_action = yes

			OR = {
				NOT = { original_tag = IRE }

	ireland_action_organise_county_candidates = {
		icon = GFX_decision_ireland_organise_county_candidates
		visible = {
			original_tag = IRE
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_archived }
			ireland_reveal_election_campaign = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_action_organise_county_candidates_locked }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = ireland_action_organise_county_candidates_requirements_tt

			original_tag = IRE
			ireland_reveal_category_elections = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_category_elections_at_capacity }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_action_organise_county_candidates_active }
			check_variable = { ireland_dail_mandate < 95 }
				any_owned_state = {
					state = 135
				}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_dail_mandate
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
						compare = less_than
					}
					has_political_power > 22
					command_power > 29
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_dail_mandate
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_dail_mandate
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_watch
						compare = less_than
					}
					has_political_power > 17
					command_power > 24
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_dail_mandate
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_watch
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
					has_political_power > 12
					command_power > 19
				}
			}
			has_political_power > 12
			command_power > 19
			}
		}
		ai_hint_pp_cost = 23
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
		custom_cost_text = ireland_action_cost_organise_county_candidates
			days_re_enable = 90

			}
			set_variable = {
				ireland_action_scope = 2
			}
			set_variable = {
				var = ireland_action_political_cost
				value = 13
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				add_political_power = -13
			}
			set_variable = {
				var = ireland_action_command_cost
				value = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_dail_mandate
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				ireland_apply_action_scarcity_severe_surcharge = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = {
							var = ireland_dail_mandate
							value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
						check_variable = {
							var = ireland_dail_mandate
							value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_watch
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
				}
				ireland_apply_action_scarcity_watch_surcharge = yes
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = ireland_action_burden_tt

						compare = less_than
					}

				}

			always = yes

			# dependence it creates and opens the existing reaction window. Equipment
			# sufficiency is awarded only when the selected delivery mission resolves.
			set_temp_variable = {
				var = ireland_procurement_source
				value = 0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 0 compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = ireland_domestic_manufacturing_complete
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					var = ireland_procurement_source
					value = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 0 compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = ireland_british_channel_open
					ireland_british_partner_valid = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					var = ireland_procurement_source
					value = 2
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 0 compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = ireland_american_channel_open
					ireland_american_partner_valid = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					var = ireland_procurement_source
					value = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 0 compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = ireland_german_channel_open
					ireland_german_partner_valid = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					var = ireland_procurement_source
					value = 4
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 0 compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = ireland_neutral_states_channel_open
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					var = ireland_procurement_source
					value = 5
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 2 compare = equals } }
				add_to_variable = {
					var = ireland_british_leverage
					value = 6
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 3 compare = equals } }
				add_to_variable = {
					var = ireland_american_leverage
					value = 6
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 4 compare = equals } }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 1 compare = equals } }
				set_country_flag = ireland_action_procure_rifles_and_support_equipment_domestic_origin
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 2 compare = equals } }
				set_country_flag = ireland_action_procure_rifles_and_support_equipment_british_origin

			}
			if = {

				set_country_flag = ireland_action_procure_rifles_and_support_equipment_american_origin
				set_country_flag = ireland_mission_complete_an_american_procurement_mission_active
				activate_mission = ireland_mission_complete_an_american_procurement_mission
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 4 compare = equals } }
				set_country_flag = ireland_action_procure_rifles_and_support_equipment_german_origin
				set_country_flag = ireland_mission_test_a_german_arms_promise_active
				activate_mission = ireland_mission_test_a_german_arms_promise
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 5 compare = equals } }
				set_country_flag = ireland_action_procure_rifles_and_support_equipment_neutral_origin
				set_country_flag = ireland_mission_keep_an_essential_cargo_route_open_active
				activate_mission = ireland_mission_keep_an_essential_cargo_route_open
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 2 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 3 compare = equals }

			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 2 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 3 compare = equals }

						check_variable = { var = ireland_procurement_source value = 5 compare = equals }

				ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
			}

				ireland_recompute_readiness = yes

	# Establish a Transitional Authority — Belfast Urban and Harbour
	ireland_action_establish_a_transitional_authority = {
		icon = GFX_decision_ireland_establish_a_transitional_authority
		visible = {
			ireland_reveal_occupation_entry = yes
			original_tag = IRE
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_archived }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_action_establish_a_transitional_authority_locked }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = ireland_action_establish_a_transitional_authority_requirements_tt

			original_tag = IRE
			OR = { has_country_flag = ireland_occupation_active has_country_flag = ireland_provisional_northern_authority has_country_flag = ireland_integration_review }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_category_occupation_integration_at_capacity }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_action_establish_a_transitional_authority_active }
			check_variable = { ireland_administrative_reach < 95 }
				any_controlled_state = {
					state = 119
				}
			has_manpower > @IRELAND_TRANSITIONAL_AUTHORITY_MANPOWER_GATE
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_administrative_reach
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
						compare = less_than
					}
					has_political_power > 24
					command_power > 39
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_administrative_reach
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_severe
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = ireland_administrative_reach
						value = constant:ireland.action_scarcity_watch
						compare = less_than
					}
